name: Symbia Energy
description: Data-centre energy monitoring: validates meter readings, joins facility and IT power, derives PUE, and persists the result. A forcing function for the platform, not a product — the defect ledger it produces (energy/API-MEASUREMENTS.md) is the deliverable.

site.description: Site identifier labelling derived series. The 227-point model currently hardcodes dc1; making the site real configuration is open work (see D2, the deferred `point` resource type).

outside.why: a real data centre is not a Symbia component, so its twin should not be one either. It publishes readings exactly as a field site would, and keeps a truth ledger of what was true versus what was published
external producers deliver to a declared ingress; delivery is not a platform concern. It holds no state and computes nothing
kept as the testable reference implementation of refusal semantics, so the rule that `incomplete` has no edge to a value stays assertable without a container rebuild
